item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"interest_aggregation","rationale":"Blend each GRU state with its causal recency-weighted prefix: 80% current state and 20% pooled states, with a five-step half-life. Applies to all four category models during training and inference; the predictor writer already imports this model class from train.py.","edits":[{"find":"        pooled = numerator / denominator.clamp_min(torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny)\n        return pooled.to(out.dtype)","replace":"        pooled = numerator / denominator.clamp_min(torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny)\n        return 0.8 * out + 0.2 * pooled.to(out.dtype)"}]}],"change_summary":"Implement the specified causal 80/20 recurrent-state readout without changing the GRU backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer, or routing."}
